Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 23

“For one free of attachment and liberated, whose mind is established in knowledge, who acts as sacrifice — the whole of that action dissolves away.”

The verb matters: it dissolves, rather than being forgiven or repaid. Action offered as sacrifice never accumulates into anything that must later be settled, which is why Krishna keeps insisting the work was never the problem.
